❓ How to use this app

🎬 Watch the 8 steps (about 1 minute)Press ▶ to start

👆
Tap ▶ to watch how to use the app. It plays only when you press it, and you can pause or jump to any step.

📖 More details — tap any topic (search works too)

🚀 Quick start (1 minute)
  1. On the Home screen tap one of the four sections (Book, PYQ, Bank or Combined).
  2. Tick the papers (or chapters) you want to practise.
  3. Choose which questions, feedback mode, order, how many and an optional timer.
  4. Tap the big Start · N questions button at the bottom of the same screen.
  5. Answer the questions. At the end you get your score, review and a Retry wrong & skipped button.
💡 Everything is saved automatically on your device. No login, no internet needed.
🏠 Home screen

Top tiles

Four numbers: total MCQs in the selected section, number of papers, how many MCQs you have attempted, and your overall accuracy.

Unfinished quiz box

If you left a quiz midway, a yellow box appears: Resume continues exactly where you stopped; Discard deletes that unfinished quiz.

The four sections

SectionWhat it contains
CMA BOOK MCQsMCQs from the books, all 8 papers, organised chapter-wise.
CMA PYQ MCQsPast exam question papers, organised term-wise (Jun 18 – Jun 26).
CMA BANK MCQsThe question bank, all 8 papers, organised paper-wise.
Combined MCQsPaper → chapter view that merges everything, including PYQ, with duplicates removed.

Tap a section to open its selection screen. The small line under each section shows your current selection.

Start button

Starts a quiz with your current selection and settings. It is disabled when nothing matches (for example, “My mistakes” while you have no mistakes).

Tool buttons (bottom row)

Browse · Analysis · Progress · Scan · Backup · Reset · Help. Each is explained in its own section below.

📚 Choosing papers & chapters (selection screen)
  • Tap a paper chip to select / unselect it (highlighted = selected). The number on the right is how many MCQs it has.
  • Select all / Clear select or unselect every paper in one tap.
  • In Book and Combined sections, open a paper to see its chapters and tick only the chapters you want.
  • In PYQ, choose the exam terms (e.g. Jun 26, Dec 25…) you want to practise.
  • The screen is split into 1 · Choose papers and 2 · Which questions? with all quiz settings below.
  • Tap Start · N questions when ready — your choices are remembered.
⚙️ Quiz settings explained

Which questions?

All questionsEvery MCQ in your selection.
Not attempted yetOnly MCQs you have never answered — best for finishing the syllabus.
My mistakesOnly MCQs your latest answer got wrong — best for revision.
Bookmarked ★Only MCQs you starred.

The small number under each filter shows how many questions it will give you. If a filter has none, the app switches back to “All questions” and tells you.

Feedback mode

  • Instant feedback — after you pick an option it locks, shows right/wrong and the explanation immediately. Best for learning.
  • Exam mode — you can change answers freely; results and explanations appear only at the end. Best for test practice.

Question order

In sequence keeps the book/paper order; Random shuffles the questions.

How many questions

All, 15, 25, 50, 100 or 200 questions per quiz.

⏱ Timer (countdown)

Off, 10, 20, 30, 60 minutes, or Custom (type your own minutes). When time runs out the quiz is submitted automatically. With the timer off, a normal stopwatch counts up.

Shuffle answer options

Mixes the order of A/B/C/D so you learn the answer, not the position. It is skipped automatically for questions whose options say “both” or “all of the above”.

📝 Taking a quiz

Top bar

  • Count (e.g. 5/25), the progress bar, and two clocks: Q = time on this question, big clock = total time (or time left if a timer is set).
  • ▦ Grid — opens the question grid (see below). ✕ Exit — leave the quiz.

Answering

  • Tap an option to answer. In Instant mode it locks and shows the correct answer plus explanation.
  • In Exam mode, tap the same option again to un-answer, or tap another to change.
  • ← Prev / Next → move between questions. Next on the last question finishes the quiz.

Buttons on the question

  • ★ Bookmark — save the question to revise later (use the “Bookmarked ★” filter).
  • 🗣 Read aloud — reads the question and options out loud (needs device speech support). Tap again to stop.

Question grid ▦

A numbered map of all questions. Colours: yellow = answered, green = correct, red = wrong, white = unanswered, ★ = bookmarked. Tap any number to jump there. Finish now ends the quiz early.

Keyboard shortcuts (computer)

A–D or 1–4 answer · ← → (or Enter) move · S bookmark · R read aloud.

Leaving & resuming

If you exit or close the app, your quiz is saved. Open the app and tap Resume on the Home screen. Your answers count towards your progress as you answer them.

🏁 Results & review
  • Score card — correct, wrong, skipped and percentage.
  • Performance by paper — which paper you did best/worst in.
  • PYQ term-wise breakdown — appears when the quiz had PYQ questions.
  • ↻ Retry wrong & skipped — instantly starts a new quiz with only the questions you got wrong or skipped.
  • New quiz — back to Home.
  • Review answers — tabs All / Correct / Wrong / Skipped / Bookmarked. Open any question to see your answer, the right answer and the explanation. Long lists are paged.
🔎 Browse (read the whole bank)
  • Type in the search box to find any word in a question, option or explanation.
  • Use the paper drop-down to limit the list to one paper.
  • Show answers switch reveals / hides the correct answers and explanations.
  • Results are paged — use the page buttons at the bottom.
💡 Great for quick revision of a topic without taking a quiz.
📊 Analysis (what examiners ask)

Analysis shows patterns in the question sets — where to focus your study. Choose a syllabus tab: 📜 PYQ, 📚 Books or 🏦 Bank.

  • Paper-wise weightage — how many MCQs each paper has.
  • Chapter-wise weightage — which chapters carry the most MCQs (pick a paper first).
  • Exam-wise frequency map (PYQ) — a heat-map of how many questions each chapter had in every exam; darker = asked more.
  • Frequently asked topics (PYQ) — topics repeated across exams; 3× or more is highlighted red.

Use the chart-type buttons to switch between column, line, pie and donut views.

📈 Progress report (how YOU are doing)

Progress shows your own performance. It has four tabs and a chart-type picker (Column, Line, Pie, Donut):

  • 🕒 24 hours — MCQs answered each hour in the last day, plus paper-wise results.
  • 🏆 All time — overall completion (correct / wrong / not attempted) and the last 14 days.
  • 📘 Papers — a bar for every paper. Tap a paper to open chapter-wise progress. Papers below 60% accuracy (after 10+ answers) are flagged Needs work; weak chapters are flagged too.
  • 🔥 Weak topics — topics you get wrong most. Filter by paper, see the top 10 chart, and tap ▶ Practice to quiz yourself only on your mistakes in that topic. Red = wrong 3 or more times.
💡 Daily and hourly history starts building from the day you begin using the app; older attempts still count in “All time”.
📷 Scan — add your own MCQs

Turn photos, PDFs or pasted text into your own practice section called SCAN.

  1. Tap Scan on Home.
  2. Add pages: choose photos / PDF / .txt files (many at once), or 📸 Take a photo, or paste text.
  3. Write the answer under each question like Answer: B, or include a key such as Answers: 1-B 2-D …
  4. Options: Enhance photos (sharper reading) and PDF: always read as images (use if PDF text looks garbled).
  5. Tap Scan → and keep the screen open. Large books may take a few minutes. ■ Stop & review lets you stop early.
  6. Check & import: fix any misread text, tap A/B/C/D beside an option to mark the correct one, use Apply key for missing answers, Remove incomplete to drop bad ones.
  7. Under Save into choose ➕ New list (and type its name) or add to one of your existing lists, then tap Import. Duplicates are skipped automatically.

Afterwards a SCAN paper appears and Practise scanned MCQs shows on Home. Under “Your scanned lists” each list has ▶ Practise (quiz only that list), 📂 Edit MCQs (change or delete single MCQs), ✎ Rename and 🗑 Delete. Everything works offline. The reading engine downloads once and may need internet the first time.

💾 Backup & restore (important!)

Your attempts, mistakes, bookmarks, settings and scanned MCQs live only inside this browser. If you clear browser data, change phone or browser, you will lose them — so back up regularly.

  • ⬇️ Download backup — saves a .json file.
  • 📋 Copy backup — copies the text; paste it into a note or chat to yourself.
  • 📂 Choose backup file or paste the text and tap Restore from text — brings everything back (it replaces the current data on the device).
💡 Back up weekly and before clearing browser data, updating, or switching phones.
↺ Reset

Deletes all attempts, mistakes, bookmarks, progress history and any unfinished quiz on this device. A confirmation appears first. It cannot be undone — take a Backup first if unsure. Your theme, scanned MCQs and settings are not part of this reset.

🎨 Look & feel (the small floating buttons)
▦ Layout & colourPick a whole-app layout (Classic, Focus, Dashboard, Booklet) and a colour theme (Midnight, Ocean, Forest, Royal, Crimson, Night, Day).
Aa Text styleFont (Classic, Serif, Mono, Rounded, Easy-read), text size (Small → X-Large) and text colour (Standard / High contrast).
🔊 SoundTurn sounds on/off, choose volume, and choose Silent during exam mode.

All choices are remembered automatically. Tip: use Night for studying in the dark and Large text for easier reading.

🎯 Smart study plan (suggested)
  1. Learn: Book section · Instant feedback · In sequence · one chapter at a time.
  2. Cover: use “Not attempted yet” to finish every chapter.
  3. Fix: use “My mistakes” or Progress → Weak topics → ▶ Practice until they turn green.
  4. Know the exam: study Analysis → Frequently asked topics, then solve PYQ term-wise.
  5. Test: Exam mode · Random · 50 or 100 questions · with a timer.
  6. Revise: star hard questions and use the “Bookmarked ★” filter before the exam.
🛠 Troubleshooting & FAQ

Does it work offline? Yes. Only the first-time Scan engine download needs internet.

Can I install it like an app? Yes — in your browser menu choose “Add to Home screen” / “Install app”.

My progress disappeared. Browser data was probably cleared or you opened it in a different browser/phone. Restore from your Backup.

Start button is greyed out. Your selection has no questions. Select more papers/chapters or change the filter to “All questions”.

Read aloud does nothing. Your device or browser may not support speech; try Chrome / Safari or install a text-to-speech voice.

No sound. Check the 🔊 button — sound may be off, low, or set to silent in exam mode — and your phone’s volume/silent switch.

Scan misread words. Turn on “Enhance photos”, use clear well-lit photos, and correct text in the review step.

Charts look empty in Progress. Answer some questions first — charts fill up as you practise.

Storage full. Delete old scan batches, then try again.

Page looks old after an update. Close and reopen the app, or refresh the page.
